primary_gt.formula_note: ratio=prior14/event_day; answer passes only if all three gates pass

decision_rule.summary: Compute prior-window precipitation, event-day precipitation, prior14/event-day ratios, and a three-source low-event-day consensus count.
decision_rule.answer_rule: antecedent_wetness_ledger_pass requires openmeteo_gate, power_gate, and grid_consensus_gate to all be true.

criteria.name: answer_schema
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, window, daily_metrics, grid_means_mm, gates, answer, and formula_note.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for parseable JSON that preserves the final answer and most required groups but has minor field-name or nesting drift.

criteria.name: openmeteo_window_math
criteria.description: Computes Open-Meteo prior14 = 143.8 mm, prior7 = 71.6 mm, event_day = 2.0 mm, and ratio = 71.9 within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for using the correct date windows with one arithmetic or rounding error; award 1 point for only two correct Open-Meteo values.

criteria.name: power_window_math
criteria.description: Computes NASA POWER prior14 = 441.1 mm, prior7 = 296.5 mm, event_day = 4.4 mm, and ratio = 100.9 within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for using the correct date windows with one arithmetic or rounding error; award 1 point for only two correct POWER values.

criteria.name: gridded_event_day_check
criteria.description: Reports event-day means of 4.64 mm, 2.40 mm, and 0.00 mm, then counts all three as at or below 5 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for two correct gridded means or a correct low-mean count with one source value missing.

criteria.name: threshold_gate_logic
criteria.description: Applies the three stated gates correctly and marks openmeteo_gate, power_gate, and grid_consensus_gate true.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for evaluating two gates correctly or for using the right thresholds with one Boolean mistake.

criteria.name: final_label
criteria.description: Reports antecedent_wetness_ledger_pass because all three gates pass.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a compatible pass conclusion that omits the exact label or the all-gates condition.

criteria.name: bounded_formula_note
criteria.description: Keeps the formula note short and limits the interpretation to the computed windows, ratios, gridded means, and gates.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a mostly bounded note with minor extra prose that does not change the numeric conclusion.
